item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Security forces seized a Kuki-Zo camp in Manipur, arrested 17 suspects for impersonating SoO cadres and confiscated a large arms cache while chief minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh urged surrender of illegal weapons and linked gun culture to the violence. Kashmir IGP called for action against over-ground workers and hybrid terrorists, urging police to become more intelligence driven. Congress demanded the resignation of the Manipur chief minister, fresh elections and dissolution of the assembly. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
